name: MetaLab Concept Testing
tagline: A complete 28-slide concept-testing readout with Work Sans, orange and cream, circular imagery, product prototypes and three offline motion backgrounds.

palette.description: White and warm cream canvas, dark neutral Work Sans typography, orange labels and phase markers, circles and independent product screens.
palette.heading: #18181A

typography.style: Work Sans is the main deck typeface, embedded from the exact Google Fonts legacy URL used by the source. The two cover titles retain original OFL Muli SemiBold 600. Six small phase numbers on slides 20–21 use portable OFL Bodoni Moda Bold instead of proprietary SchnyderS Cond; this is the only font substitution. Source weights, line heights, letter spacing and paragraph frames are preserved; type inside product screenshots remains image content.

best_for: Product concept-testing reports that connect the research ask and prototypes to findings, user quotations, design implications, phased business/UX recommendations and sprint next steps.
avoid_for: Dense financial dashboards or evidence-free marketing claims. Keep each finding and prototype within its source frame; duplicate the related finding layouts for additional findings.

source_inspiration.name: MetaLab — Concept Testing (Pitch), complete 28-page public template
source_inspiration.notes: All 28 source pages, including instructions, appendix and resources, reconstructed in their original order as static native HTML/CSS/SVG from public slide objects and measured source DOM. Product screenshots/photos are independent replaceable image slots. Thirteen plain raster phone-frame instances are rebuilt as native SVG; six small proprietary SchnyderS Cond phase numbers use editable Bodoni Moda Bold as the documented portable-font substitution; three source background videos are embedded as real 1080p offline MP4 with posters. Source resource credits are retained. This reconstruction does not require Pitch or JWPlayer runtime.
